Retaining their martial skill, these powerful ghouls are not afraid to meet their foe in the open, feeding on the flesh of their fallen opponents to learn their combat abilities. **[Recall Knowledge - Undead](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 16 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11 [Ghoul Soldier](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3010) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 163 **Perception** +8; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +9, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +8, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +6 **Str** +3 **Dex** +2 **Con** +2 **Int** +1 **Wis** +2 **Cha** +3 **Items** [Bastard Sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=15), [Breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=10) --- **AC** 17 **Fort** +8 **Ref** +8 **Will** +6 **HP** 28 ([void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=83)) **Immunities** bleed, [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) **Reactive Strike**
**Stench** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664)) 10 feet, DC 15 --- **Speed** 25 feet, burrow 5 feet **Melee** jaws +11, **Damage** 1d10+3 piercing **Melee** bastard sword +11 ([two-hand d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=198)), **Damage** 1d8+3 slashing **Melee** claw +11 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 1d8+3 slashing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Consume Flesh** ([Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) 2d6 HP **Ghoul Whispers** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) DC 18 **Grave Knowledge** ([Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) +8 skill modifier **Swift Leap** ([Move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114))
